name: Media
short: Radio streaming, music link nominations and social embed fixing in one cog.
description: Streams a radio URL into voice with automatic join and leave and now-playing status (Radio), lets members nominate music links to a channel by reacting (MusicBoard), and reposts social media links through a webhook with working embeds (EmbedFixer). Each feature can be turned on or off per server in /control. Replaces the separate Radio, MusicBoard and EmbedFixer cogs and keeps their saved settings.
author: itsneufox
install_msg: Media loaded. If you used Radio, MusicBoard or EmbedFixer, unload them first; their settings carry over. Configure everything in `/control` (Media). Members use `/media play`, `/media stop` and `/media fixlinks`. Radio needs ffmpeg and PyNaCl on the host.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per server: radio stream, status API and channel settings and the radio status message ID; MusicBoard settings and IDs of nominated messages; EmbedFixer settings (sites, services, ignored channels and roles); and per member, whether that member opted out of EmbedFixer. It does not store message content or voice audio.
